title: One-Step Start Command and Auto-Setup UX
problem: Current Master Control UI exposes bootstrap complexity. Operator should paste one start command in a sub thread and that thread should self-bootstrap and start work without extra user setup steps.
fullPrompt: Implement a one-step handoff flow: Task Packet should be enough for a sub thread to fetch its prompt from Master Control Ops and execute setup automatically (including any needed project bootstrap checks) with no extra operator decisions. Remove or de-emphasize bootstrap-heavy UI from primary path and keep advanced setup behind secondary controls.
doneCriteria: User can copy/paste one command/packet into a sub thread and that thread starts immediately, handling setup itself. UI no longer blocks operator with bootstrap complexity for normal use.
reportBack: Append summary with before/after flow, exact start command behavior, and verification evidence.
modelReason: Workflow-critical UX and behavior changes with cross-cutting impact.
